field_edits.updated_text: Cervical spinal alignment is maintained. No significant spondylolisthesis. Normal cervical lordosis.
Vertebral body heights are maintained. No acute compression fracture or focal suspicious marrow-replacing lesion. Postoperative changes are noted at C5–C6. Normal marrow signal.
Cervical spinal cord is normal in caliber and signal intensity. No intramedullary T2/STIR hyperintensity, cord edema, or myelomalacia. No cord compression.
Disc height maintained with adequate hydration. No significant disc bulge or herniation. No significant spinal canal or neural foraminal stenosis.
Mild disc desiccation with small broad-based disc bulge causing mild ventral thecal sac indentation and mild bilateral neural foraminal narrowing.
Disc desiccation with broad-based disc bulge/minimal central disc protrusion, mild ventral thecal sac indentation, bilateral neural foraminal narrowing, without significant cord impingement.

Postoperative changes with residual posterior disc-osteophyte/disc protrusive component causing indentation of the ventral thecal sac and ventral cervical cord with central canal narrowing. No cord signal abnormality or edema.
Disc height and hydration are relatively maintained. No significant disc bulge, herniation, spinal canal or neural foraminal stenosis.
No significant disc bulge, herniation, canal or foraminal stenosis.
